map_single_address: Reads references/map.md before mapping (or the equivalent skill file for maps).

Proposes exactly one address-endpoint request for 12 Example Ave with limit=1 and no paid flags (zoning, enhanced ownership, matched addresses/buildings all false or omitted); no extra request for geometry.
Saves the decoded response verbatim (not reformatted or trimmed) to a RESPONSE.json file.
Proposes `python3 <skill>/scripts/map.py render RESPONSE.json OUTPUT.html` without --replace unless the user asked to replace a file.
Presents the page (absolute path or interactive page) and states the match status from the response; never invents a status before a result exists.
Does not paste geometry or coordinates into chat.
map_with_neighbours: States the cost (one request, up to 25 records) before proposing the neighbours call.
Proposes exactly one /parcels/point request using the subject lat 39.9005 and lon -75.0295 with radius=100, limit=25, return_geometry=true, and paid datasets off.
Saves the neighbours response verbatim to NEIGHBOURS.json.
Proposes map.py render RESPONSE.json OUTPUT.html --neighbours NEIGHBOURS.json.
Makes no other lookup request and does not re-request the subject.
Does not paste geometry into chat.
export_spreadsheet: Proposes `python3 <skill>/scripts/map.py export RESPONSE.json --csv FILE.csv` (optionally also --geojson), reading the saved response.
Tells the user the export made no extra requests and names the output file.
Does not paste geometry or the full table into chat.
explain_field: Proposes no regrid_request call for the explanation.
Proposes /schemas only if the local catalog lacks usedesc; otherwise does not use it.
Answer ties the explanation to the supplied record's value, Single Family Residential, without inventing owner or valuation claims.
freshness_mcp_only: Reports the supplied parcel's ll_last_refresh (2026-09-17) as that parcel's refresh date.
States that county-level pull dates need the CLI (regrid verse / freshness helper) and are not available over MCP alone.
Proposes no /verse call and no other regrid_request call.
Does not present the parcel date as the whole county's freshness.
mistyped_address: Records the typeahead permission error once and does not retry typeahead.
Does not substitute a guessed corrected address as an exact match or call address/path on it without user confirmation.
Asks the user to confirm or correct the address (for example 12 Example Ave, Haddonfield NJ).
Does not treat the error as an authentication failure of the whole connection or claim the property does not exist.
Any proposed request count stays within one new request.
geometry_absent: Proposes running map.py render on the saved response (or reports the outcome described) and does not edit RESPONSE.json to force a pass.
Reports the helper's one-line failure: the response omits geometry, so boundaries were not returned.
Proposes no automatic re-request; offers a re-request with return_geometry only if the user authorizes it, noting it is one more request.
Does not claim a map was produced or describe a boundary.
non_us_map: Says the request is out of scope: the skill covers US parcels only.
Proposes no regrid_request, map.py, or other tool call.
Does not fabricate a Toronto parcel or map.
